17.q: Environmental lapse rate can be more than DALR

ex.1: ELR (6.8) < DALR (9.8): a lifted dry parcel cools faster than its surroundings and sinks back → stable.
ex.2: ELR (4.5) < SALR (5.5): even saturated air is stable.
ex.17: A super-adiabatic lapse rate (ELR > DALR) occurs over strongly heated ground: absolutely unstable.
ex.13: At very low temperatures (below −40°C) there is so little water vapour that latent heat release is negligible.
